name: list-pending-actions
description: List all pending approval requests awaiting principal decision: actions the autonomy gate blocked and is holding for approval. Returns short_ref, description, skill name, and expiry for each. Call it when the principal answers an approval notification or asks what is pending. Match the principal's words to a request by its description ("approve the calendar event" → the request for the calendar action), then pass its short_ref to approve-action, deny-action, or dismiss-action (dismiss when the principal handled it outside Curia). When only one request is pending, short_ref can be omitted. If several are pending and it is unclear which one the principal means, show them the list and ask.
